cases.name: Infant eyes and remote exception
invariants: Preserve partial OR complete closure for infants, newborn emphasis, and explicit exception role or unresolved exception relation.

negative_controls.criterion: Do not generalize to every adult or fabricate a resolved target.

cases.name: Adjacent infant propositions
invariants: Preserve support, tilt permission and parent-face prohibition independently, whether grouped or separate.

negative_controls.criterion: Do not require car seat, invent a tilt angle, or allow parent face because support is allowed.

cases.name: Coordinated standards and appearance/certificate qualifications
invariants: Keep six months, likeness, identification and application timing; should plus separate must-request consequence; hairstyle OR facial hair permitted if likeness remains; certificate timing caution.

negative_controls.criterion: No fixed day conversion, certificate issue-date substitution, lost identification predicate or blanket reuse permission.

cases.name: Different signing actors
invariants: Applicant need not sign; acceptance agent signs back for hand-carry cases.

negative_controls.criterion: No applicant duty, prohibition of all signatures, or universal agent signing duty.

cases.name: Damage boundary
invariants: Keep no-longer-good-likeness OR impeded recognition, facial area, both immaterial categories and explicit acceptance; retain examples as examples.

negative_controls.criterion: Do not classify harmless image effects as material or require both tests/categories simultaneously.

cases.name: Temporary glasses and urgent/emergency travel
invariants: Should issue limited-validity passport using endorsement 46 when temporary medical need AND urgent OR emergency travel.

negative_controls.criterion: No one-year import, missing endorsement, must upgrade, or travel-only condition.

cases.name: Soft versus hard force
invariants: Distinguish mandatory medical-glasses statement request from should for eyes, rare evidence and referral; explicitly preserve uncertain typing if vocabulary cannot express it.

negative_controls.criterion: Empty issues or kind requirement must not imply every should is mandatory.

cases.name: Inherited DS-11 case
invariants: Carry no photograph AND acceptance facility from suspension sentence into applicant re-execution; retain distinct actors.

negative_controls.criterion: An otherwise complete DS-11 is not assigned this duty; nearby claims/IRL alone do not restore scope.

cases.name: Positive local relationship control
invariants: Retain medical glasses exception, signed statement, four child links and additional dark/tint necessity. Review scope/prerequisite taxonomy.

negative_controls.criterion: No fabricated target, false link-corruption claim, rejection of correct OR grouping or automatic acceptance without lens necessity.

cases.name: Disability antecedent and window boundary
invariants: Preserve disability in described possible inability-to-produce-expression circumstances; connect available baseline or explicitly identify unresolved relation.

negative_controls.criterion: No any-disability broadening, mandatory diagnosis/proof or invented absent-window quotation.

cases.name: Medical eye closure and rare unlikely cause
invariants: Keep one OR both eyes with causal medical condition and discretionary acceptance; rare AND unlikely cause with should signed-statement request; distinguish trigger from baseline exception.

negative_controls.criterion: Do not flip unlikely, drop rare from aggregate representation, require statement universally, or make acceptance mandatory.

cases.name: Return object and purpose
invariants: Return the application to adjudication for printing-defect context, to request a new photograph.

negative_controls.criterion: Do not make photograph the returned object or infer a separate must-request command from purpose.

cases.name: Remote reference topic
invariants: Keep unresolved 8 FAM 1001.2 specifically about DS-5504 photo importing plus separate DS-5504 suspension duty.

negative_controls.criterion: No invented import procedures or permission to accept a missing-photo DS-5504 at counter.

cases.name: Forms and receipt location
invariants: Retain DS-11 OR DS-82 counter refusal, DS-11 facility suspension, DS-82 OR DS-5504 suspension and both IRLs.

negative_controls.criterion: No fixed row count, both-forms conjunction, imported facility restriction or exclusive IRL mapping.

cases.name: Advisory versus descriptive language
invariants: Keep reasonableness/certificate guidance advisory while may wish and may have remain descriptive.

negative_controls.criterion: No invented duties from headings, revision dates, examples or preferences.
